description: SPENDS MONEY. Orders one Mac (or Jetson), billed monthly to the card already on the account. Only call this when the user has asked for another machine; say the tier and monthly price first (see catalog: tiers marked orderable). An in-stock tier is charged and handed over, or set up, within the hour; a built-to-order one is queued, online within 48 hours, and charged when the Mac is reserved. Returns the order as it stands: poll get_order until status is delivered, then the order id is the machine id for get_machine and get_credentials. Refused when the token has used its order limit (forbidden), when there is no card on file (payment_method_required: a person adds one on the dashboard, the API never takes card details), and for special orders and the Mac Studios (arranged on the dashboard). Needs the order scope.

idempotency_key.description: Required. One unique string with no spaces per Mac you mean to order, such as a UUID. If this call fails or times out and you try again, pass the same value: you get the first order back, never a second Mac.

software_bundle.description: What comes installed. Leave out for the default: a bare Mac, or the Jetson stack on a Jetson.

use_case.description: Optional: what the machine is for, a line for the team

name: place_order
title: Order a Mac
